description: Source code for the quic_memory_cache_backend.cc implementing an in-memory cache backend for QUIC protocol, including response management, server push, and WebTransport support.

classes.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::ResourceFile
classes.description: Represents a resource file with methods to read headers, set host/path, and handle URLs.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::ResourceFile::Read
methods.description: Reads file contents and parses HTTP headers, extracting status, URL, push URLs, and body.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::ResourceFile::SetHostPathFromBase
methods.description: Sets host and path from a base URL string.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::ResourceFile::RemoveScheme
methods.description: Removes http:// or https:// scheme from a URL.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::ResourceFile::HandleXOriginalUrl
methods.description: Overrides URL based on X-Original-Url header.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::GetResponse
methods.description: Retrieves a cached response for given host and path.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::AddSimpleResponse
methods.description: Adds a simple HTTP response with status code and body.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::AddResponse
methods.description: Adds a response with headers and body to the cache.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::SetResponseDelay
methods.description: Sets a delay for a response.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::AddResponseWithEarlyHints
methods.description: Adds a response with early hints.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::AddSpecialResponse
methods.description: Adds a special type of response.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::InitializeBackend
methods.description: Initializes cache from directory, reading resource files and setting responses.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::GenerateDynamicResponses
methods.description: Creates dynamic responses, e.g., for byte generation.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::FetchResponseFromBackend
methods.description: Fetches response based on request headers.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::CloseBackendResponseStream
methods.description: Closes response stream (no-op).

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::GetServerPushResources
methods.description: Retrieves server push resources for a request URL.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::ProcessWebTransportRequest
methods.description: Processes WebTransport requests.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::AddResponseImpl
methods.description: Internal method to add responses with various parameters.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::GetKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key from host and path.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::MaybeAddServerPushResources
methods.description: Adds server push resources if not already present.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::PushResourceExistsInCache
methods.description: Checks if a push resource already exists in cache.
